summary: Episode discusses three upcoming IPOs (TouchTech, 2CureX, ESN Esport) and provides a comprehensive introduction to commodities investing, explaining how different commodities are priced and various ways to gain exposure. Emphasizes commodities are historically undervalued compared to stocks.
key_takeaways: Fortnox continues to show strong growth and is non-cyclical
New AI-powered ETF AIEQ launched using IBM Watson for stock selection
Commodities are historically undervalued versus stocks, potential 30-50% upside
Three IPOs covered: TouchTech (digital retail), 2CureX (cancer treatment), ESN Esport (esports broadcasting)
Multiple ways to invest in commodities: futures, certificates, ETFs, commodity-exposed stocks
